a260825p1.summary: A roughly 45% slump in the shares of Unitree, China's best-known humanoid robot maker, since a more than fivefold jump …
a260825p1.title: Unitree shares fell 45% after surging more than 5x in their August 19 Shanghai debut, cutting its valuation from $66B to $36B, raising robotics bubble concerns (Reuters)

a260825p10.summary: Pixel phones appear to be the first devices to get Google's Motion Assist feature. — • … TL;DR
a260825p10.title: Google is rolling out Motion Assist, a feature to reduce motion sickness by showing visual cues on the screen, to Android 17, starting with select Pixel devices (Adamya Sharma/Android Authority)

a260825p11.summary: Chinese tech giant's Xring O3 3nm AI processor scheduled to debut aboard folding smartphone in September
a260825p11.title: Xiaomi unveils the Xring O100, a 6nm AI accelerator to boost its MiMo models when paired with its O3 mobile chip, and the 3nm Xring D100 for autonomous driving (Iris Deng/South China Morning Post)

a260825p12.summary: A research duo, once pitched to lead the Jeff Bezos-backed Project Prometheus, on Tuesday unveiled what they've built on their own …
a260825p12.title: Accelerated Understanding launches an enterprise-focused physics AI model that uses neural operators and handled 5T pieces of data in a single prompt in tests (Jeffrey Dastin/Reuters)

a260825p13.summary: OpenAI has banned a cluster of ChatGPT accounts originating in Russia that it said were being used to support a covert online influence campaign to spread misinformation.
a260825p13.title: OpenAI bans a cluster of Russian ChatGPT accounts that used VPNs to evade restrictions and run an influence operation, including creating social media comments (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)

a260825p14.summary: Emerald AI, now valued at $1.05 billion, uses software to keep power demand at the computing facilities from getting out of control.
a260825p14.title: Emerald AI, which uses AI to optimize data center power consumption based on grid demands, raised $150M led by DCVC and Energize Capital at a $1.05B valuation (Sri Muppidi/New York Times)

a260825p15.summary: Luffu, a new startup from Fitbit's co-founders James Park and Eric Friedman, on Tuesday launched Luffu Link …
a260825p15.title: Fitbit co-founders James Park and Eric Friedman unveil the $250 Luffu Link, a screenless, jewelry-inspired LTE health and safety band, set to ship in early 2027 (Aisha Malik/TechCrunch)

a260825p16.summary: Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) on Tuesday expanded its Gemini Enterprise artificial intelligence platform with new tools for lawyers and law firms …
a260825p16.title: Google launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal, expanding its platform with specialized AI agents and integrations with Thomson Reuters, LexisNexis, and Harvey (Mike Scarcella/Reuters)

a260825p17.summary: Is the best handheld screen worth an extra $300 to you? … The Asus Xbox Ally X20 looked like it could be one of the best handheld gaming PCs yet …
a260825p17.title: Asus opens pre-orders for the standalone Xbox Ally X20 at $1,300+, with shipments from October 15; a $2,500 bundle includes the X20 and ROG Xreal R1 glasses (Sean Hollister/The Verge)

a260825p18.summary: Apple's most powerful Mac raises the bar for local AI with up to 4.3x faster performance, more advanced graphics, up to 512GB of unified memory, and extensive connectivity
a260825p18.title: Apple updates the Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra, with up to 4.3x faster AI performance, faster graphics, and up to 512GB of unified memory for $2,499+ (Apple)

a260825p19.summary: Mac mini delivers up to 4x faster AI performance, up to 2x faster graphics and storage, along with enhanced connectivity — all in its ultracompact footprint
a260825p19.title: Apple unveils a Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro, with up to 4x faster AI performance and up to 2x faster graphics, for $899+ with M6 and $1,699+ with M5 Pro (Apple)

a260825p2.summary: Airbound, an Indian startup building autonomous drones, has raised $37 million in fresh capital as it pushes to make moving goods through …
a260825p2.title: Bengaluru-based autonomous drone startup Airbound raised a $37M Series A led by Greenoaks, less than a year after an $8.65M seed, taking total funding to ~$50M (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)

a260825p20.summary: Apple is introducing the M6 chip with a new Mac Mini. It's also launching a new M5 Ultra alongside an upgraded Mac Studio.
a260825p20.title: Apple unveils M6, a 2nm chip with a 12-core CPU and GPU, and up to 32GB of unified memory, saying it provides "the world's fastest single-threaded performance" (Jay Peters/The Verge)

a260825p3.summary: In short: — Australia's main music charts have announced a ban on AI-generated music to start this week.
a260825p3.title: Australia's ARIA says songs created mostly or entirely by AI will be excluded from its charts; a song that used AI became the most-played song on radio in July (Cam Wilson/ABC)

a260825p6.summary: The hit-making duo turned tech moguls also have thoughts about why corporate America isn't collaborative enough.
a260825p6.title: Q&A with Dr. Dre and Jimmy Iovine on lessons from Apple's Beats acquisition, creativity, being pro-AI music creation, AI as a tool like drum machines, and more (Jordyn Holman/New York Times)

a260825p7.summary: Eight months after implementing a ban on under-16s accessing social media services like TikTok, Australia finds its younger users …
a260825p7.title: Qustodio: 26% of Australian children aged 13 to 15 were on TikTok in July, just one percentage point below pre-ban levels, and 10-to-12-year-olds' usage is up (Newley Purnell/Bloomberg)

a260825p8.summary: Next Tuesday, Tim Cook will officially pass the baton as Apple CEO to his successor, John Ternus.
a260825p8.title: Tim Cook is set to step down on September 1, and a source says Apple hosted an intimate farewell party; sources say Cook's assistant will work with John Ternus (Aaron Tilley/The Information)

a260825p9.summary: ChapsVision pursues defence and intelligence contracts across the region as governments look to reduce reliance on US technology
a260825p9.title: A profile of French software maker ChapsVision, which won a contract to replace Palantir at France's domestic intel agency in June and targets an IPO by 2030 (Adrienne Klasa/Financial Times)
